answer: Pay every reward in a distinct pigment: each identity's earnings carry a unique dye recorded in a public atlas of flows. Honest agents keep or spend their own dye separately, so their trails stay single-coloured. A farmer running many identities must eventually pool the proceeds to use them, and one transaction carrying dozens of pigments is a mixture no honest agent ever makes. Collecting the payoff is what exposes the farm — the juniper-branching flows converge, and the blend itself is the proof of common control.
